title: След, который блестит

beats.action: Mia and Stepa crouch beside the marked path at a respectful distance from the snail; neither touches it.
They notice a faint shiny trail on a leaf near the ground without moving the leaf.
beats.camera: gentle close-up, keep hands out of frame

beats.action: Mia points from a distance while Stepa looks carefully at the same spot.
They look at each other, curious, then return their gaze to the trail.

safety_gates: Observe without touching the snail, trail, or nearby plants.
Dialogue timing is approximate and does not use phoneme-level lip sync.
